initial_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: production pixel art animation master sheet for Human Last Rampart. Create ONE transparent PNG with exactly 4 columns and 4 rows, 16 equally spaced cells, no labels or grid. Each cell has ONE small identical olive green goblin with brown mohawk, huge pointed ears, yellow eyes and bright white glint, two tiny ivory fangs, brown leather vest/harness and ragged loincloth with square brass buckle, chunky bare feet and a wooden club. Reference 1 is the approved 56 pixel goblin identity; reference 2 is side profile identity; reference 3 hero is STYLE ONLY (chunky pixel clusters, dark 1-native-pixel outline, big head, short sturdy body, 3 shades/material). Do not copy human clothing or blue eyes onto goblin. Match goblin face and olive palette. All cells same camera/scale, front three-quarter view, club in same hand. Render as crisp low-resolution game pixel art enlarged by integer pixels, no smooth illustration, no gradients. Each standing goblin should occupy ~56 native pixels height, head ~20. Keep full body and club within each cell with broad clear transparent gutters. Fixed feet level in each row and fixed body center column, no shadows or particles.
ROW 1 WALK left to right: left foot planted/right knee forward; passing pose; right foot planted/left knee forward; opposite passing. Subtle arm swing. Faces viewer slightly toward left.
ROW 2 CLUB ATTACK left to right: ready with club down; club raised high above shoulder; powerful downward club strike leaning forward; recovery ready. Feet stay planted.
ROW 3 FALL left to right: hit recoil upright; crouch knees buckling; tipping sideways on one arm; fully lying on side on ground, eyes closed. Keep ground level consistent, do not shrink fallen character. Club stays held in all poses to avoid disconnected pixels.
ROW 4 WALL STRIKE left to right: three-quarter SIDE view facing left ready; two handed club hoisted overhead leaning back; club extended diagonally down LEFT to strike at knee-height earth wall; recovery shoulders forward. Both feet planted. No wall inside asset, no dust, no effects. Strong visibly different silhouettes from walking.
Exactly 16 poses in 4x4 regular grid, transparent background, no extra objects.
